{{Top|leg}}
'''Voria's Ember''' was a quadrant of the [[Karthakk system]]. It was named after [[Voria Sergar]], a former [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] who had been found in the wilderness of [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] and became a skillful [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] and [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. She was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in this system when her [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was struck by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Missile/Legends|missile]].
